message: Resolving the violation on line 30 requires converting `src/helpers/snapshot.coffee` from a factory function returning closure-bound helpers (`export default ( rootDirectory ) -> ...`) into a stateless namespace whose step functions accept and return context state. Under single-file scope, changing the module export from a factory function to a stateless namespace alters its public interface contract and would break callers expecting `snapshot(rootDirectory)` without the ability to refactor consuming modules across the project.
